tests.newRegression: Two background-focus cases failed before the fix and passed after it; TV configuration regression confirms seek bar rather than automotive Forward button.

diagnosis: Old harness targeted an automotive-only Forward button. Separately, inactive KidMode route kept focusable native controls behind playback. The fix unmounts those controls while preserving route state; correct TV seek-bar path passes native log checks.
limits: Logs establish emitted focus/media/seek events, not actual pixels, visible rings, audio, captions, VoiceView or compositor timing.
No physical TV, independent detector or loop-seam acceptance.
Saved household, sound preference, volume, approved catalogs and keys unchanged.
No screen/video recording or computer-use capture.
An interrupted first source-test attempt included controlStudy, which exported in-memory component JSON only. No screen or image capture occurred; final suite explicitly excluded it.
Historical full remote Fast Forward checks belong to source 0a54252; current native seek check uses TV seek bar.
